Why Reliability Matters in Water Transport?

In agriculture, construction, or disaster relief, the efficient and safe transport of water is non-negotiable. Whether you are hauling thousands of gallons for irrigation, dust control, or supplying potable water to remote sites, the integrity of your tanker trailer is paramount.

Maral Sanat Javid, a leading Tanker Trailer Manufacturer, specializes in engineering robust and high-capacity Water Tanker Trailers designed to meet the toughest industry demands. Our trailers are not just transport vehicles; they are custom-built solutions optimized for longevity, safety, and operational efficiency.

Key Features of Maral Sanat Javid Water Tanker Trailers

Our Maral Sanat Javid Water Tanker series stands out due to its commitment to quality materials and engineering excellence. We focus on delivering maximum legal payload while ensuring superior durability and compliance with international safety standards.

1. Superior Tank Construction and Materials

The heart of our trailer is the tank, engineered for safe, long-term liquid transport.

  • Material Excellence: The tank is primarily built from high-grade ST52 carbon steel for exceptional structural strength and durability, or stainless steel (304/316) for specialized applications like a Potable Water Tanker. This choice ensures optimal corrosion resistance tailored to the transported liquid.
  • Optimal Capacity Range: We offer an extensive range of sizes, catering to all project scales. Popular models include the high-efficiency, multi-axle configurations such as the 3-Axle Water Tanker and High-Capacity Water Trailer, allowing clients to select the perfect volume (typically up to 35,000 liters) for their specific hauling requirements.
  • Advanced Baffling System: Full-width internal surge baffles are strategically welded within the tank. This critical feature significantly minimizes the sloshing effect (surge) of the liquid during acceleration, braking, and turning, thereby enhancing vehicle stability and driver safety, especially when carrying partial loads.
  • Manholes and Access: Tanks are fitted with large, sealed manholes at the top to facilitate inspection, cleaning, and maintenance, ensuring the integrity of the transported water.

2. Robust Chassis and Running Gear for Tough Terrain

The infrastructure beneath the tank is the foundation of the trailer's resilience, engineered to handle heavy water loads and challenging off-road environments common in construction, mining, and agriculture.

  • Chassis Frame: Constructed from high-strength, robotically welded steel beams (often St52-3), the chassis is designed to withstand extreme torsion and flexing stresses inherent in hauling heavy bulk liquids.
  • Axle Configuration: We utilize proven European or Turkish brand axles (such as BPW or SAF) known for reliability and longevity. Standard configurations often include 3-Axle Water Tanker setups with a 12-ton capacity per axle, ensuring optimal load distribution and weight management compliance.
  • Suspension System: Equipped with heavy-duty Air Suspension systems, which provide superior shock absorption compared to traditional leaf springs. This protects both the trailer structure and the road surface, ensuring a smoother ride for the Semi Water Trailer.
  • Braking and Safety: Features include an advanced dual-line air braking system, incorporating leading technologies like EBS (Electronic Braking System) and ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) from global suppliers (e.g., WABCO or Knorr-Bremse), guaranteeing reliable and controlled stopping power under full load.
  • Landing Gear: Heavy-duty, two-speed mechanical landing gear provides stable support when the trailer is uncoupled.

3. Customization and Application Versatility

Maral Sanat Javid operates on the principle that the optimal trailer is a perfect fit for its specific job. We specialize in building truly Customized Water Tanker solutions:

  • Pumping Systems: Options for various centrifugal or displacement pumps, powered by the tractor's PTO or an auxiliary engine, with high flow rates suitable for rapid loading/unloading and specialized tasks.
  • Spreader and Spray Bar Options: Trailers can be configured with rear or side spray bars, nozzles, and canons, making them essential tools for construction site dust suppression, road wetting, and fire control.

​​​​​​​

Diverse Applications

  • Agricultural Use: Ideal for large-scale Agricultural Water Transport for irrigation, field spraying operations, or livestock watering.
  • Construction & Mining: Essential for civil engineering projects, road base preparation, and equipment wash-down.
  • Emergency & Municipal: Configured for rapid deployment and the quick delivery of large volumes of water for relief operations or municipal fire fighting supply.
